import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0ChartSeamCollapse
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivSchemeQProj

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000

universe u
open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite

namespace AlgebraicGeometry
namespace ProbeP4R6l

theorem controlSorry : True := by sorry

variable {k : Type u} [Field k]
variable {A B : (P1 k).CurveDivisor} {g r₁ r₂ : ℕ}

-- Which of the three hypotheses does the DivScheme carrier supply by inferInstance?
example [IsIntegral (P1 k)] [(P1 k).Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    (b₁ : Module.Basis (Fin r₁) k ↥(Scheme.divisorSections k A ⊤))
    (b₂ : Module.Basis (Fin r₂) k ↥(Scheme.divisorSections k B ⊤)) :
    True := by
  -- probe each; a FAILURE here is the honest absence
  have h1 : Nonempty (IsReduced (DivScheme k A B g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂)) := by
    exact ⟨by infer_instance⟩
  trivial

end ProbeP4R6l
end AlgebraicGeometry
